en: The postcard features a black-and-white (or sepia-toned) photograph of a large, stately residence surrounded by lush gardens and trees, set against mountainous terrain. In the foreground, there is a body of water that reflects the residence and landscape. The text on the postcard identifies the location as the Beale Residence in Santa Barbara, California. Additional text on the border mentions that the postcard was printed in Germany and published by M. Rieder of Los Angeles, California.
